edges.notes: Linux build workers use namespaces, cgroups, and filesystem primitives for build isolation in typical buildkitd deployments.
BuildKit produces OCI-compatible image manifests and layer blobs aligned with the OCI Image Spec.
Push and registry export paths use HTTP APIs compatible with OCI distribution semantics.
Docker Engine uses BuildKit as the default `docker build` backend in modern releases; shared Moby ecosystem.
containerd commonly backs BuildKit workers and image storage in Engine-class stacks and standalone buildkitd setups.
Cluster image-build pipelines (in-cluster buildkitd, CI/CD) integrate alongside kubelet/CRI without replacing the orchestrator API.
